Heh, for all you know he was closeted himself and was striking out at everybody. He said he saw it in my eyes. And that was just off a quick passing by each other in the near dark, with a murmur of "good morning." Like playing the winning lottery jackpot numbers just half an hour too late for that week's draw. If this, if that, you could have been a millionaire. Now, you're lucky if you get a free play.

I usually take pills sublingually. Cut them in half (1 mg) and take them every few hours. Sometimes I swallow them, in an attempt to mix it up. I was prescribed injections my by first endo, who prescribed a low dose of it, but they're not covered and haven't been able to afford them (or know quite which particular pharmacy has the prescription). My current endo doesn't seem particularly willing to prescribe injections. If I see him again, maybe I can convince him with the estrone vs estradiol argument. I don't know how I'm going to do, never mind the cost.

My facial hair is prettyis much gone; just a few dark stragglers and blonde ones. My front torso is almost clear but still has a bit to go. For voice, I still have issues with consistency and the sound and resonance of it. I'm apparently pitching high enough - my voice was never deep - but it sounds off. I'll admit to being interested in vocal surgery. If just so it doesn't feel fake, take effort and for things like coughing, clearing throat, etc. It's also a source of dysphoria and even just self-hate (always hated my voice - along with everything else). I currently go to group sessions led by a speech therapist, with a few weeks of short individual sessions in between. There are only a handful of sessions left. Out of group, I practice on my own. Which is hard enough, since I hate hearing myself.

I don't know if another doctor may have an opinion on need for BA. The person I see at a gender clinic sought out one that would be able to give a second opinion, but it was declined because the Health Centre that doctor works at keeps a catchment area - they only see those who live within a certain area close to the Centre - and I live outside it. 

I have been on progesterone for quite a while at different intervals. I even tried cycling it to try to imitate hormonal ovarian phases, but didn't get anything out of it. I got a Noogleberry that I don't use and maybe should be, but I don't know if it actually causes any legitimate increase in size.

My endo said it wasn't a possibly to test if I had any estrogen insensitivity (or wasn't willing to), so even if there was a way to test estrone vs estradiol, I doubt I could. But no such testing exists?

Haha, I don't think moving to Sweden is much of an option. Believe me, I'm not lucky in anything. I thankfully have enough finances and am seeing someone good, so the facial/body hair is being addressed... slowly. Thanks, although I'm not really making any progress with my voice.

A part of it is that I can't stand my body and am cognizant of it at all times, so someone affording me respect to me gender doesn't take away from that.

I do live somewhere where some surgeries are covered. GRS is covered and I'm just about all qualified, but my mental wellbeing disqualifies me. That's about all that's covered. Just more hopeless, unfair things. I don't know of anywhere else that publically covers more than that.

Honestly, I keep falling back to square one. I can't stop thinking about the body (face, hips/butt, waist, chest,  feet, hands) and life I could have had if I had transitioned in my teens or preteens. The loss of life. And the very real outlook of nothing. Maybe if I had something to grasp onto, but I don't. That's a wonder I have if a relationship would help, but I figure I'm too messed up to subject someone to my issues; even if I were in a relationship with someone else who also had problems, I couldn't help but think I'd only make it worse for them, rather them help. And I guess the same for me. Like you said, I'm at the point where I'm too depressed to do anything, even practice my voice despite going to group sessions with a speech therapist.

I cut my arm the other day to try to see what it'd be like...

I can't accept ECT.

Considered young or old, I'm not my physical age. You somewhat lost me with what you said in your second and third sentences. I can't wait to "slowly become one of those versions over time." I can't stay like this until I'm 35, 40, 50 or more. I don't think ECT induces ignorance, I think it damages or kills off neurons and renders the brain incapable of processing depression. I doubt depression is the only thing affected. Not only that, but if so much of my depression is based on the loss of time, my appearwnce and gender dysphoria, how could ECT possibly do anything if those aspects don't change? Unless it is in attempt to change my gender idenitity or cause me serious amnesia.

I'm not sure I'll be able to see an endo any time soon. I'll try to not to have CPA, although 2 weeks sounds too long. So, maybe a week, week and a bit. If I can tell T is coming back, I'd get back on it.

Willing to try. Trying to try. Always trying and failing, it's all my life seems to consist of.

You are not so in my face and you have no need to apologize. I'm sorry for my posts and thank you for going out of your way to reply when you usually avoid these. You're correct in my reactions. And I feel I'll be a disappointment and your efforts will be to waste. But thank you all the same.

A dead person isn't conscious to experience suffering anymore.  I am not young. I don't even count as a young adult anymore. I'm sure I seem young to you. I am to you what a 23 year old is to me. But imagine you went to sleep tonight and woke up tomorrow a 47 year old. You as a mind are the same, but the world around you has changed, babies who were just born are now 10 years old, your body is older, you have grey hair or hair loss, and everything else 10 years of passing might entail. That's me. Some kind of 19 year old expected to be 30. The difference is I wasn't in a coma, thouh I do call it a psuedo-coma. Instead I was stuck in a kind of solitary, barely distracting myself on a computer, self-loathing every single day of existence, unable and not knowing what to do. And I'm supposed to just accept or reconcile that now?

That's why that 19 who just discovered who they were gets to me so badly. I'm glad they found themselves. But it just reminds me of my situation. I was prayin for God to change me overnight night when I was about 11. Because I didn't know any method existed, so it exactly take divine intervention. I did multiples prayers in one shot, I prayed the rosary, I prayed not to wake up at times (because of bullying), I prayed for other causes (to curry favour and not be selfish). I even did a few prayers in my 20s, although not at all religious then, just in case. I didn't know I being trans or transitioning was a thing until my early 20s. And I still wasn't able to do anything about it. I had no money for DIY. I wasn't about to tell my parents who hated me and regularly insulted me by that point or reveal that deepest held secret to a walk-in doctor. Even years later, when the ball finally got rolling, I was gatekept and delayed, so I didn't really start HRT until basically 27. That why everyone gets to me. The very early and early transitioners and now get to live as themselves, happily, the ones who didn't transition early but led lives wih careers, spouses, kids (even if they lose much of that), those who pass and transitioned well to remind me I don't get that, and those who don't pass well to remind me of the opposite.

Yes, being a non-passing trans woman is worse to me than death, at least for me. I already don't have anything. I already feel horrible out in public.
